user.title: Add a VTech camera
user.description: How do you want to give the camera's credentials?

menu_options.manual: Type the camera's UID and password

camera.title: Camera pairing QR
camera.description: On the parent unit, open the camera's "Connect Mobile Phone" pairing QR code. Scan it with any phone QR-code reader and paste the text it shows (a long base64 string) here.

pick_camera.title: Choose a camera
pick_camera.description: This pairing QR holds several cameras. Choose the one to add now. To add another, add the integration again with the same QR; cameras already set up aren’t offered.

manual.title: Camera UID and password
manual.description: The camera's 20-character UID and its AV password, for example as printed by the cloud credentials helper (see CREDENTIALS.md in the repository). The integration works out the security mode itself.

untested_model.title: Untested camera model
untested_model.description: This camera reports its model as {model}. This integration has only been tested with the {tested}, so with this camera some features may not work or may behave unexpectedly, and some may not appear at all. Submit to add it anyway, or close this dialog to cancel. If you do add it, please report how well it works, with the integration's diagnostics attached.

update.title: New credentials for {name}
update.description: The camera's credentials change whenever its Wi-Fi changes or its security key is updated. How do you want to give the new ones?

menu_options.update_qr: Paste the current pairing QR text (recommended)

update_qr.title: Re-pair {name}
update_qr.description: Scan the camera's current pairing QR code on the parent unit ("Connect Mobile Phone") and paste its text here. It may hold several cameras; the one for {name} is used.

update_manual.title: Re-pair {name}
update_manual.description: The current AV password of camera {uid}.

error.invalid_qr: This isn’t a pairing QR this integration recognises. Paste the full text the QR reader shows.
error.unsupported_model: The pairing QR marks this camera as a model it doesn’t support.
error.invalid_uid: A camera UID is 20 letters and digits.
error.wrong_camera: This QR code belongs to a different camera.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected these credentials. They change after a Wi-Fi change or a security key update: use the current pairing QR, or the current password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera. Make sure it is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.module_unavailable: The integration's protocol module could not be loaded; see the logs.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already configured (every camera in a pasted QR, if it holds several). If its credentials changed, use Reconfigure, or wait for Home Assistant to ask you to re-pair it (Settings → Repairs).

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating VTech Baby Monitor
restart_required.description: A new version of the integration's protocol module is installed, but the one loaded when Home Assistant started keeps running until Home Assistant restarts.

get_motion_events.name: Get motion events
get_motion_events.description: Returns the camera's stored motion history (the camera stores motion only), newest first.
